title: Willie Stargell Leaf Inc. Diamond Kings Puzzle Pieces 55, 56, 57.
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a rare and valuable Willie Stargell Leaf Inc. Diamond Kings Puzzle Pieces trading card. It features the legendary baseball player and is perfect for any sports fan or collector. The card is in great shape and has been well-preserved, making it a great addition to any collection. 

The card is a Sports Trading Card with a Diamond parallel/variety and is numbered 56. It also includes puzzle pieces and is manufactured by Leaf. This is a must-have item for any fan of Willie Stargell or baseball in general. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this rare card to your collection.
